status: measured. This closes the open verification remainder of S4-G100-ACAF-REGEN-001, which recorded a mechanism and marked it NOT VERIFIED BY RE-EXECUTION. It has now been re-executed twice. The mechanism is confirmed and one of that finding's remainders is resolved in a direction the finding could not have settled from the artifact alone.
subject: artifacts/s4_g100/summaries/acaf_frame_sweep.json against artifacts/s4_g100/reproductions/acaf_frame_sweep_r1r_linux.json
what_was_open: S4-G100-ACAF-REGEN-001 found that a regeneration of a file declared preserved changed 924 leaves: 923 continuous last-bit drifts in rows[*].gap_k, and ONE discrete change, rows[232].sheaf_maxdev moving 4/238 -> 3/238. It proposed that a tie at the extremal frame resolved the other way under last-bit noise, and stated explicitly that confirming this required re-running the sweep under both float environments, which had not been done.

method.command: experiments/run_acaf_frame_sweep.py, executed twice, with its single write site redirected to a scratch directory so the committed artifact was never touched
method.why_redirected: the script's only output path is OUT / 'acaf_frame_sweep.json', which is the committed file itself. Running it in place would have overwritten the very artifact under examination -- the exact act the superseded finding is about.
method.determinism: the sweep is fully seeded: numpy.random.default_rng(31337) drives frame generation and default_rng(7) drives localisation. There is no unseeded randomness.

measurement_1_the_sweep_is_deterministic.design: two independent executions in the same container, same interpreter, same libraries
measurement_1_the_sweep_is_deterministic.why_it_matters: it removes the alternative explanation. The differences against the committed file are not run-to-run nondeterminism; this code, on fixed inputs, gives the same answer every time it is asked in one place.

measurement_2_the_population_split_repro.design: leaf-by-leaf exact comparison of the reproduction against the committed file, 15207 leaves, identical key sets
measurement_2_the_population_split_repro.significance: this is the SAME 923 + 1 split the superseded finding reported for the original regeneration, recovered independently on a third environment. The split is a property of the computation, not of the one transition that was first noticed.

measurement_3_the_statistic_is_bistable_.the_controlling_observation: rows[232].sheaf_auroc is BIT-IDENTICAL at 235/238 across the committed file and both reproductions. The identity-frame score ordering never moves. Only the worst-frame departure does.
measurement_3_the_statistic_is_bistable_.verdict: CONFIRMED. sheaf_maxdev = max(|v - identity_value|) over admissible frames, where each v is an AUROC on the 1/238 pair grid. A maximum over a step function of floating-point scores is discontinuous in its inputs, so a tie at the extremal frame resolves either way under the same last-bit perturbation visible in the 923 gap_k leaves. The statistic moves by a full grid unit while every continuous quantity moves by 1e-14.

resolution_of_the_direction_remainder.what_was_open: the superseded finding recorded that the single discrete change moved the reported worst-case deviation DOWN, making the sheaf invariant look one count more robust after regeneration, and noted that 'a favourable drift is precisely the kind that goes unquestioned'.
resolution_of_the_direction_remainder.resolved: this environment reproduces the UNFAVOURABLE value, 4/238, twice. The statistic is not drifting in a preferred direction; it is not reproducible across environments in either direction. No selection is indicated and none is now suspected.
resolution_of_the_direction_remainder.what_this_does_not_absolve: the commit that carried the regeneration still described the S4/G100 artifact surface as preserved while 924 leaves changed. That remains a statement about intent rather than about bytes, and nothing yet enforces it.

what_is_not_claimed: that the tie was observed directly. The mechanism is confirmed by its signature -- a full grid-unit jump in a discontinuous statistic, coincident with last-bit motion elsewhere, with the identity-frame score frozen -- and not by instrumenting the frame comparison and watching two AUROCs cross. That instrumentation was not written.

that any S4/G100 conclusion changes. sheaf_mean_auroc, win_rate, invariance_breaks and equivariance_failures are all in the unchanged set, in the original regeneration and in this reproduction. No headline moves.

that sheaf_maxdev is wrong. It is a legitimate worst-case statistic. What is established is that it is not REPRODUCIBLE at grid resolution across float environments, so it must not be compared between environments as though a one-unit difference meant something.
cross-platform anything. Two runs, one Linux container. The committed file was produced elsewhere and that environment was not available to re-run.

typed_remainders.statement: the reproduction establishes that the value differs between this environment and whichever produced the committed file. It cannot establish which is 'correct', because neither is: both are legitimate resolutions of a tie. Any downstream use of sheaf_maxdev at grid resolution inherits this and none was audited.

the fix suggested by this finding -- report sheaf_maxdev with an explicit tie tolerance, or report the multiset of frame AUROCs rather than their maximum -- was NOT implemented. The statistic is unchanged and will do this again.

inherited unresolved from the superseded finding. No automated check enforces that a commit declaring an artifact surface preserved has preserved it. R1R added such a check for manifest pointers and none for artifact bytes, and the 924-leaf discrepancy still had to be found by hand-diffing two blobs.

Built and measured by the Claude session on the Linux container. Witness-nerve rank 0: verifier equals producer. The party that made the original change was unavailable then and is unavailable now, so the reading of intent is still one party's.
